source: Supplied v3.3 retains v3.2 Annexes J/K/L and adds Annex M; latest user-confirmed rules take precedence
baseline: Version266 Stage254; preserved prior development contracts. Historical v3.1 Library item currently updated to v3.3; immutable original not available.
catalogue: 35 functional headings sharing the existing application/services, not 35 applications

rows.Existing behavior: Owner-private identity; demonstration personas; identity/grant adapters deny live activation
rows.Required change: Scoped effective-dated multi-role grants; appointment-led President activation and approved delegation templates
rows.Dependencies: Official SSO/trusted identity and named authorities

rows.Existing behavior: Academic profiles and fictional bulk progression; history preserved
rows.Required change: Course/class roster source snapshots, source freshness and reconciliation
rows.Dependencies: Official MIS source contract

rows.Existing behavior: Workshop/seminar/project delivery and session evidence
rows.Required change: Conference/event scope separate from eligibility; assigned course roster; shared plan authority
rows.Dependencies: Roster mapping, templates and principal plan route

rows.Existing behavior: Individual intake and trusted team first-review backend; default provider registry empty
rows.Required change: Preserve faculty/Coordinator course routing; Academic endorsement before Research; shared final plan approval
rows.Dependencies: Current faculty/course mappings and trusted roles

rows.Existing behavior: Assigned criteria, versioned submissions, evidence verification and human reviews
rows.Required change: Team counts/capacity, skill requirements separate from academic eligibility; appointed confirmed participants only
rows.Dependencies: Participant/recruitment contract

rows.Existing behavior: Requests, reviewer decisions and membership exit/history
rows.Required change: Approved capacity, open-until-full intake, waitlists and atomic last-seat acceptance
rows.Dependencies: Approved capacities and concurrent CAS tests

rows.Existing behavior: Proposal, authorization, activation, renewal, suspension and historical records
rows.Required change: Reconcile formation, committee activation and plan authority without circular gates
rows.Dependencies: New committee and plan controls

rows.Existing behavior: Mentor appoints individual leader; leadership term/history retained
rows.Required change: 9–11 committee, three-month succession, semester-six appointment snapshot, Student Affairs review, Principal confirmation, appointment letter then manager activation
rows.Dependencies: Term length, selection method, role templates and signatory holders

rows.Existing behavior: Versioned annual plans; mentor then Student Affairs currently approves
rows.Required change: Unit review then mandatory Finance Administrator and Principal; preserve approved versions and apply change control
rows.Dependencies: Shared approval route, named institutional authorities

rows.Existing behavior: Volunteer applications, selection, role tasks and confirmed event handoff
rows.Required change: Broader entry modes, waiting lists/replacements, appointment letters and organizer-specific final report
rows.Dependencies: Participant and committee authority

rows.Existing behavior: Budget review, revisions, release, expenses and settlement controls
rows.Required change: Mandatory pre-execution plan route; consolidated joint budgets; distinguish post-event settlement
rows.Dependencies: Finance Administrator versus financial/payment authority mapping

rows.Existing behavior: Club contribution summaries and historical records
rows.Required change: Term-linked committees, appointments, partnerships and finance obligations with privacy
rows.Dependencies: Verified source linkage and committee lifecycle

rows.Requirement: Club evaluation annual review and handover
rows.Existing behavior: Annual reviews, outgoing/incoming handover and verified club evaluation
rows.Required change: Committee-wide independent evaluation and persistent obligations under new appointment route
rows.Dependencies: Committee policy and alternate evaluator assignments

rows.Existing behavior: Mentor acceptance, transfer/handover, independent task and individual evaluation
rows.Required change: One faculty account with separately scoped effective-dated responsibilities/workload; leadership never implies scoring
rows.Dependencies: Named assignments, authority windows and rubric policies

rows.Existing behavior: Individual free-text reflection, human evaluation, immediate sharing and in-app submission acknowledgement
rows.Required change: Separate knowledge/skills/leadership/impact sections; advisory AI with human fallback; evaluator alerts
rows.Dependencies: Approved rubric/AI privacy configuration; AI not required for human path

rows.Existing behavior: Independent issuance, correction, revocation and minimal verification
rows.Required change: Role-specific certificate categories; external credentials retain issuer; no registration-only achievement
rows.Dependencies: Approved eligibility and issuer/signatory policies

rows.Existing behavior: Self-declared CV separate from verified records; private export and consent sharing
rows.Required change: External verified status, role contribution and validity indicators
rows.Dependencies: External achievement verification

rows.Existing behavior: Verified individual/club projections and guarded source invalidation
rows.Required change: Lead, faculty, department and institution projections; duplicate-free shared event counts; independent learning recognition before settlement
rows.Dependencies: Shared source IDs and validity/revocation rules

rows.Existing behavior: Task academic snapshots and historical period reporting
rows.Required change: Verified external achievements earned during enrollment and applicable completeness denominators
rows.Dependencies: Historical enrollment mappings

rows.Existing behavior: Persistent workflow reminders and source-validity checks
rows.Required change: Capacity/succession/principal-plan/change-request triggers with source-version deduplication
rows.Dependencies: New workflow events and approved notification timing

rows.Existing behavior: Project/thread discussion and retained moderation history
rows.Required change: Extend record-scoped contexts to plans, budgets, research and meetings without authority substitution
rows.Dependencies: Context permissions and retention policy

rows.Existing behavior: In-app inbox and approved reminder policies; email sending disabled
rows.Required change: Current evaluator/Finance/Principal queues and reliable delivery reconciliation
rows.Dependencies: Live sender setup and new workflow events

rows.Existing behavior: Versioned independent documents, acknowledgement and private attachments
rows.Required change: Approved committee/recruitment appointment letters with issuer/signatory/scope/dates; no fabricated signature
rows.Dependencies: Approved appointment and signing authority
rows.Implementation status: Partial; document revision defect corrected at Stage254

rows.Existing behavior: Audience-targeted notice drafts, approvals, acknowledgement and expiry
rows.Required change: Recruitment and approved-change propagation, no private/public boundary bypass
rows.Dependencies: Participant and approved-change source contracts

rows.Existing behavior: Private allowlisted attachments, size/structure/hash checks and download role guards
rows.Required change: Malware scanning/quarantine and failure-unavailable states; confidentiality/retention
rows.Dependencies: Approved scanner and retention operations

rows.Existing behavior: Student, mentor, coordinator, research, Student Affairs and administration demo dashboards
rows.Required change: Finance Administrator and Principal scoped plan queues; multi-responsibility faculty view
rows.Dependencies: Trusted role assignments

rows.Existing behavior: Scoped verified metrics and denominator labels
rows.Required change: Cross-club unique event totals, committee/partnership measures and confidential drill-down
rows.Dependencies: Source identity/deduplication and approved measures

rows.Existing behavior: Faculty/mentor planning and task/learning views
rows.Required change: Course responsibility schedules, conflicts/vacancies and advisor/coordinator scope; not HR appraisal
rows.Dependencies: Academic role/roster source mapping

rows.Existing behavior: Source-linked assigned actions and detailed-process navigation
rows.Required change: Distinct Finance/Principal plan, report and change-request actions; stale revalidation
rows.Dependencies: New review/propagation events

rows.Existing behavior: Academic coordinator/department plan chain; club mentor/Student Affairs chain; versioned draft revision/import controls
rows.Required change: All plan kinds require unit → Finance Administrator → Principal, even zero cost; exact-version immutable approvals; Annex M controlled additions/extensions
rows.Dependencies: Named authorities; Principal-originated plan rule remains unresolved
rows.Implementation status: Conflict; route enforcement not yet adopted

rows.Existing behavior: Research intake routing/mentor acceptance; trusted first-review helpers, execution handoff incomplete
rows.Required change: Academic screening/endorsement then Research review; faculty-led accepted groups, appointments, authorship and independent faculty-output review
rows.Dependencies: Ethics/IP, scope assignments and configuration

rows.Existing behavior: Single-club source event and contribution chain
rows.Required change: One event/budget/report, partner acceptance/obligations and one accountable evaluator/student; unique institutional counts
rows.Dependencies: Shared event/partner identifiers and approval route

rows.Existing behavior: Global supporting-unit intake and private listing boundaries; no complete agreement lifecycle
rows.Required change: National/international proposals, approved commitments, separate signing, expiry/renewal/withdrawal/closure and handover
rows.Dependencies: Formal signatories, agreement policy and external guest boundary

rows.Existing behavior: Self-declared CV only; not external credential verification
rows.Required change: Enrollment-date/issuer/credential/role/evidence/original units/hours/expiry; authenticity separate from evaluation; duplicates/revocation/appeal; no academic credit conversion
rows.Dependencies: Category reviewers, issuer checks and credit authority

rows.Existing behavior: Context discussion/tasks, not formal meeting records
rows.Required change: Agenda/invites/attendance/minutes/decisions/action owners/deadlines/follow-up, corrections and confidentiality
rows.Dependencies: Minutes reviewer and context authority
